title: Core: workflow engine — match triggers, schedule actions
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/engine/. WorkflowEngine.dispatch(event, workflows) finds workflows whose trigger matches, then executes their action graph respecting depends_on. Independent actions run in asyncio.gather. Run lifecycle: pending->running->done|failed. Per-action result captured in Context for downstream actions. on_failure / on_success hooks fire as appropriate. Engine is pure — adapters injected.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with mock adapters: single-action workflow runs end-to-end; parallel actions execute concurrently; depends_on respected; failure mid-graph triggers on_failure; success triggers on_success; final RunState set correctly.

title: Core: action type contracts and scaffolds (no I/O yet)
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/actions/. Define Action Protocol (async execute(ctx)->ActionResult). Skeletons (no real I/O): AiReportAction (just prompt rendering + stub LLM call), YtCommentAction (logs to console), SetFieldAction (logs to console). Real adapter integration lands in epic-003. Each registered via decorator. Pure dependency injection — adapters passed in constructor, defaults to no-op stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Each action type instantiates with injected dependencies. execute() returns ActionResult with success/failure. Tests assert dependency injection works and stubs do not call real services.

title: Core: YAML loader and workflow validation
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/config/loader.py. Load workflow YAML from path. Validate via pydantic Workflow model. Resolve env var references in YAML strings (e.g. ${YOUTRACK_URL}). Aggregate validation errors with file path and line numbers where possible. Schema export: dump JSON Schema from pydantic model for future UI editor.
acceptance_criteria: Valid YAML loads to Workflow object. Invalid YAML raises with helpful message. Env vars expanded at load time. JSON Schema export round-trips. Tests cover happy + several failure modes.

title: Core: plugin registry (decorator-based) for triggers and actions
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/registry/. Two registries: trigger_registry, action_registry. Decorator @register_trigger('name') and @register_action('name') attaches class to registry by string key. Lookup raises clear error on unknown type. Explicit init module loads all known plugins (no auto-scan). Type-safe via Protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Registry rejects duplicate registrations. Lookup returns class. Unknown type raises with available-types listed in error. Tests cover registration, lookup, duplicate, unknown.

title: Core: trigger types — status_change and manual
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/triggers/. Implement StatusChangeTrigger (matches IssueEvent on from_state/to_state with '*' wildcard). ManualTrigger (always matches when invoked via CLI run command). Both implement Protocol Trigger.matches(event)->bool. Register via decorator at module import.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: status_change matches correct from/to combos including wildcards; manual always matches; non-matching events return False; both registered under expected names.

title: Core: pydantic models for Workflow, Trigger, Action, Context, Run
description: Define the domain language as pure pydantic v2 models in src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/. Workflow (name, trigger, actions[], on_failure, on_success, context). Trigger (base + discriminated union). Action (base + discriminated union with id, type, depends_on, output spec). Context (immutable: issue, branch, diff, accumulated outputs). RunState enum (pending/running/done/failed). IssueEvent (incoming YT event). ActionResult. No I/O, no logic — types only. Discriminated unions via pydantic Field(discriminator='type').
acceptance_criteria: All models import cleanly. Tests assert validation errors on bad payloads. Example workflow YAML round-trips through model + dump. mypy --strict passes.

title: Bootstrap: src-layout directory structure and gitignore
description: Create skeleton: src/youtrack_aitrack/{domain,engine,registry,adapters/{youtrack,git,llm,storage},config,cli}/__init__.py + tests/{unit,integration,fixtures}/__init__.py + workflows/ + prompts/. .gitignore comprehensive Python: .venv, __pycache__, *.egg-info, dist, build, .ruff_cache, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .coverage, htmlcov, .env, .idea (PyCharm), .vscode (VS Code per-user), .youtrack-aitrack-state/. Keep existing .beads/, .dolt/, *.db, .beads-credential-key, .claude/. Remove PyCharm scaffold main.py. .env.example with placeholders + comments: YOUTRACK_URL, YOUTRACK_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, REPO_PATH, YOUTRACK_PROJECT.
acceptance_criteria: All directories present with __init__.py. .gitignore committed. .env.example committed with documenting comments per variable.

title: Bootstrap: ruff and mypy strict configuration
description: Configure ruff in pyproject.toml: line-length 100, select rule sets E/F/W/I/N/UP/B/A/C4/RUF, format-on-save compatible. Configure mypy --strict on src/ (no implicit Any, no untyped defs, disallow incomplete defs). Verify on empty scaffold.
acceptance_criteria: uv run ruff check, uv run ruff format --check, uv run mypy src all pass on empty scaffold.

title: Bootstrap: pyproject.toml with deps and uv setup
description: Foundation for all subsequent work. Create pyproject.toml: project metadata (name=youtrack-aitrack, Python 3.12+, MIT license), runtime deps (anthropic, httpx, typer, pydantic, pydantic-settings, pyyaml, jinja2, python-dotenv), dev deps (pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-mock, respx, ruff, mypy, pre-commit). CLI entry points youtrack-aitrack and yta alias. uv as build/dep manager.
acceptance_criteria: uv sync succeeds; uv.lock generated; uv run youtrack-aitrack --help and uv run yta --help return without error (even if stub commands).

title: Bootstrap: README, LICENSE (MIT), CONTRIBUTING
description: README.md: project mission (3 paragraphs), quickstart with uv tool install, link to CLAUDE.md for architecture, status: alpha. LICENSE: MIT, year 2026, author Lech Buszczynski. CONTRIBUTING.md: beads workflow summary, link to anti-drift rules in CLAUDE.md, PR/issue process.
acceptance_criteria: README has working quickstart commands. LICENSE present in repo root. CONTRIBUTING references CLAUDE.md.

title: Bootstrap: GitHub Actions CI for lint and tests
description: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml. Triggers: pull_request to main, push to main. Steps: actions/setup-python@v5 (3.12), install uv via official action or pip, uv sync, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy src, pytest. Single Python version for now (3.12+).
acceptance_criteria: CI YAML valid (yamllint or actionlint). Workflow runs all gates on PR. Failing gate blocks merge.

title: Bootstrap: pre-commit hooks for lint, format, types
description: Install pre-commit dev dep. Create .pre-commit-config.yaml running ruff check, ruff format, mypy. Document install step (pre-commit install) in CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit install succeeds. Failing lint blocks a test commit. README/CONTRIBUTING documents the install step.

title: Tooling: track .beads/issues.jsonl in git
description: bd auto-exports issues to .beads/issues.jsonl on every state change but the file sits inside gitignored .beads/, producing repeated 'auto-export: git add failed' warnings. JSONL is the canonical shared-issue format intended to be versioned. Update .gitignore to ignore .beads/* except issues.jsonl, then track the existing export.
acceptance_criteria: bd close or update no longer prints 'auto-export: git add failed'. .beads/issues.jsonl is tracked in git; .beads/beads.db and other local state remain ignored.
